# MarkaUI

> MarkaUI is a premium, MIT-licensed design system for React. 221 components across 58
> documentation families, reachable by 339+ names via an alias-aware registry — with 12
> colour themes, each shipping a complete light and dark token set. Built on Radix UI
> primitives, styled with Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes and CSS custom-property design
> tokens. TypeScript-first, ESM + CJS.
>
> COMPONENT COUNT: the advertised "339+" is computed, not hand-written. The registry
> defines 221 components grouped into 58 families; `expandAliases()` then emits an extra
> reachable name for each documented alias, giving 339 (see
> `src/components/showcase/registry/index.ts`, `TOTAL_COMPONENTS`). The component index
> below lists the 221 real components.

Canonical site: https://markaui.vercel.app
Docs: https://markaui.vercel.app/components
Live demo: https://markaui.vercel.app/demo/matrimuni
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/markaui
Source: https://github.com/markaui/markaui
License: MIT (Copyright (c) 2025 MarkaUI)

## Install

    npm install markaui

In your global stylesheet:

    @import "tailwindcss";
    @import "markaui/theme.css";
    @import "tw-animate-css";   /* optional: enter/exit animation utilities */

Since v1.0.1, `markaui/theme.css` ships a Tailwind v4 `@source` directive that registers the
component bundle automatically — no content-path configuration is required.

## Basic usage

    import { MarkaUIProvider, Button } from "markaui";

    export default function App() {
      return (
        <MarkaUIProvider defaultTheme="maroon" defaultMode="light">
          <Button variant="gold">Get started</Button>
        </MarkaUIProvider>
      );
    }

`MarkaUIProvider` carries its own `"use client"` directive, so it works inside a Next.js
server layout. It sets `data-theme` and the `dark` class on `<html>` and persists the choice
to `localStorage` under `markaui-theme` and `markaui-mode`.

## Theming

Switching the entire interface costs one attribute:

    <html data-theme="royal" class="dark">

Or programmatically via the `useMarkaUI()` hook, which returns
`{ theme, setTheme, mode, toggleMode, themes }`.

Themes: maroon (Maroon & Gold), wine (Burgundy & Honey), rose (Rose Gold), royal (Royal
Purple) — Signature group; emerald (Emerald & Brass), forest (Forest & Sage), teal (Teal &
Copper), champagne (Champagne Bronze), cocoa (Cocoa & Caramel) — Heritage group; coral (Coral
Terracotta), plum (Plum & Mauve), noir (Noir & Silver) — Modern group. Every theme has light
and dark variants, so 24 combinations, all tuned for WCAG-AA contrast.
